name: Doctoral INPhINIT Fellowships — Incoming (and Retaining) [DOCTORAL, not master's]
amount_detail: NOT FOUND — funder page returns HTTP 403. 30 Incoming fellowships + 30 Retaining fellowships in the 2026 calls.
covers: 3-year PhD in Spain or Portugal (Incoming: at accredited research centres of excellence; Retaining: at any university or research centre in Spain/Portugal).
eligibility_verbatim: "la Caixa" Foundation grants fellowships "for researchers of any nationality who wish to pursue a doctorate in any discipline at any university or research centre in Spain or Portugal". Mobility rule: candidates "must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Spain/Portugal for more than twelve months in the three years immediately preceding the closing date of the call."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: No nationality exclusion. The binding exclusions for this candidate are (a) it is a DOCTORAL programme — a master's is not fundable under it, and (b) the 12-months-in-3-years mobility rule, which a candidate who has just spent 1–2 years doing a master's in Spain may fail.
deadline_2027_intake: 2026 calls: INPhINIT Incoming closed 28 January 2026; INPhINIT Retaining closed 18 February 2026. 2027 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25.
notes: RECORDED FOR CONTEXT, NOT AS MASTER'S FUNDING. This is the one la Caixa line genuinely open to a Tunisian citizen, and it is the natural follow-on after a Spanish master's — UPF's Music Technology Group (MTG) has advertised INPhINIT PhD positions, which is directly on path codes A/B. IMPORTANT TRAP: the mobility rule bars anyone who has spent >12 months in Spain in the preceding 3 years, so doing a 2-year master's in Spain can DISQUALIFY the candidate from INPhINIT Incoming. Plan accordingly: apply while the Spain residence total is still under 12 months, or target the Retaining call instead (check its own residency wording). name: Becas Fundación Ramón Areces para Estudios de Postgrado — Ampliación de Estudios en el Extranjero (Ciencias Sociales / Humanidades / Ciencias de la Vida y de la Materia)
amount_detail: "Dotación económica: 2.100 euros mensuales NETOS." Plus enrolment/tuition fees at the destination institution ("Gastos de INSCRIPCIÓN y MATRÍCULA en la universidad o centro extranjero") and one annual return economy flight with travel/medical insurance. (XL convocatoria, Ciencias Sociales, curso 2026-2027.)
covers: One academic year of a master's abroad, extendable one further year for 2-year master's; doctorate 12 months + up to 3 extensions. Regulated postgraduate study only — bachelor's study and pure research stays abroad are excluded.
eligibility_verbatim: "I. Requisitos de los candidatos — Tener la nacionalidad española. Haber obtenido un título de licenciado, grado o máster universitario que dé acceso a los estudios solicitados: en un país del Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior o, alternativamente, en un país no perteneciente al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior, acreditando la homologación oficial del mismo por parte del órgano ministerial competente antes de la fecha que se indica en el apartado V.6 de esta convocatoria. […] Conocimiento excelente del idioma en el que se desarrollen los estudios o investigación. No ser beneficiarios de ninguna beca o ayuda económica para la realización de estudios, crédito, o cualquier otra asignación de similar naturaleza…"
exclusion_clause_verbatim: "Tener la nacionalidad española." (Bases, I. Requisitos de los candidatos, XL Convocatoria para Ampliación de Estudios en el Extranjero en Ciencias Sociales, curso 2026-2027.) A Tunisian citizen is excluded outright.
deadline_2027_intake: XL convocatoria (curso 2026-2027): "Plazo de presentación de solicitudes: desde el 21 de enero al 23 de febrero de 2026" — CLOSED. The equivalent call for curso 2027-2028 would be expected January–February 2027 but is NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. Moot: ineligible.
notes: THREE independent disqualifiers, any one of which is fatal: (1) Spanish nationality required; (2) the becas fund study ABROAD ONLY — 'estudios de postgrado en universidades y centros de investigación en el extranjero' — so they cannot fund a master's in Spain; (3) the subject areas do not include computing, AI, audio or music. The XL Ciencias Sociales call covers only Análisis económico, Distribución comercial, Economía aplicada, Economía de la empresa, Historia Económica, Derecho de la Unión Europea; the parallel calls are Humanidades and Ciencias de la Vida y de la Materia. Note the interesting detail that the title-recognition clause DOES contemplate non-EHEA degrees (with homologación) — but that concession is about where the degree was earned, not about nationality, and the nationality bar is absolute. Contact for queries: becas-economia@fundacionareces.es. fundacionareces.es returns 403 to WebFetch but WAS fetched successfully via curl with a browser User-Agent — the verbatim text above is from the funder's own page, read directly.

name: Becas Santander / Santander Open Academy (umbrella programme — scholarships delivered per call and per partner university)
funder: Banco Santander (Santander Universidades / Santander Open Academy)
amount_detail: NO SINGLE AMOUNT — this is a catalogue, not one scholarship. Each call sets its own award. "More than 900 programmes"; "+1,000 universities, institutions and organisations collaborating in 13 countries". Most catalogue items are FREE ONLINE COURSES (language, skills, tech) worth no cash to a master's student; the cash-bearing lines are the Academic Mobility, Research, Professional Internships and Financial Assistance categories, which are published per partner university.
covers: Four declared scholarship categories: "Financial Assistance — Scholarships for financial assistance to support undergraduate studies and university access for those in need. Academic Mobility — Scholarships for national and international mobility to study at another academic institution. Research — Scholarships for students and faculty to support research in a specific program or project. Professional Internships — Scholarships to facilitate access to the job market through professional internships."
eligibility_verbatim: Platform-level: "To sign up and start learning, you just need to be over 16 years old. We believe in your potential and want to help you succeed, whether or not you're a bank customer." / "Anyone can register on Santander Open Academy — you do not need to be a Banco Santander customer." / FAQ, 'Can I access from any country?': "Yes, Santander Open Academy is globally accessible. You only need an internet connection to access it from Europe, the Americas or any other region. There are no specific residency requirements for direct-access courses. There may be geographic specifications for programmes with limited places and scholarships. Always check the Legal Terms of each programme." / "Who can apply for Santander Open Academy scholarships? The scholarships are aimed at a wide variety of profiles, from university students to professionals. Each call may have specific requirements, so review the eligibility criteria."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: There is NO nationality bar at the umbrella level — the bar is institutional affiliation. FAQ, 'What happens if my university does not appear on the list?': "Some programmes are specifically aimed at students from certain universities. If this is the case and your university is not among the participants, you will not be able to apply for that particular programme. But don't worry — you are sure to find other programmes you can participate in!" And: "Partner institution programmes — The universities and institutions we work with also publish their own programmes for their academic communities." Plus the geographic caveat: "There may be geographic specifications for programmes with limited places and scholarships."
deadline_2027_intake: NOT APPLICABLE at umbrella level — deadlines are per call, rolling throughout the year, published on app.santanderopenacademy.com. NOT FOUND for any specific Spain master's call for the Sept-2027 intake.
notes: UMBRELLA MECHANICS — the answer to 'can a non-EU applicant hold one' is YES IN PRINCIPLE, NO IN PRACTICE UNTIL ADMITTED. Nationality is not a filter: registration is open worldwide to anyone over 16, no Santander banking relationship needed, and there is no citizenship clause anywhere in the platform terms. The real gate is that money-bearing Santander scholarships are issued THROUGH a partner university to ITS OWN academic community — you must already be a student of (or admitted to) a participating institution before you can even see the call in your account, and if your university is not on the list the application form will not open. CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS CANDIDATE: a Santander scholarship is NOT an admission-stage funding route and cannot be counted on when choosing where to apply. It becomes reachable only AFTER securing a place at a Spanish partner university, and then only for whatever that university happens to publish (typically mobility grants, internship grants, or small tuition-assistance awards — rarely full master's tuition). Treat it as a possible top-up in year 1, never as the plan. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: once a target university is chosen, check that university's own Santander Universidades page for the specific call and its Legal Terms (Términos legales), which is where any nationality/residency clause would live. CAVEAT ON COVERAGE: I could not enumerate the live call catalogue — app.santanderopenacademy.com/en/program/search is a JavaScript SPA that returns only an empty shell to automated fetching, and its JS bundle is served 403, so no specific Spain-master's call could be inspected. The WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before I could search for one. This is a genuine gap, not a finding of absence.

name: Becas Leonardo a Investigadores y Creadores Culturales (Fundación BBVA) — and the Fundación BBVA calls catalogue generally
amount_detail: "La dotación global de esta convocatoria está fijada en 2.750.000 euros. Se concederán al menos 55 becas, dotadas cada una de ellas con un importe bruto máximo de 50.000 euros" (convocatoria 2025).
covers: An individual research or cultural-creation project by a mid-career researcher/creator, executed over a fixed period. NOT tuition, NOT a taught master's.
eligibility_verbatim: "4/ Solicitantes — Los solicitantes serán personas físicas, investigadores o creadores culturales de nacionalidad española con residencia en España, o nacionales de otros países con residencia en España, en los términos previstos en estas bases, debiendo acreditar el requisito de residencia aportando la documentación que se indica en el apartado 5. El solicitante deberá tener una edad comprendida entre los 30 y 45 años (ambos inclusive) en el momento de la solicitud."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: "En caso de que el solicitante sea un nacional de un país no miembro de la Unión Europea, deberá aportar su tarjeta de identidad de extranjero en vigor en la que se acredite tener residencia de larga duración en España o permiso de residencia al amparo de la Ley 14/2013, de 27 de septiembre, de apoyo a los emprendedores y su internacionalización. Y, en este último caso, adicionalmente, deberá acreditar tener residencia en España de al menos tres años de antigüedad a la fecha de presentación de la solicitud aportando certificado/s de empadronamiento o informe de vida laboral que acredite la residencia en España durante los tres últimos años." (Bases Becas Leonardo 2025, apartado 5.) Plus the absolute age bar: "El solicitante deberá tener una edad comprendida entre los 30 y 45 años (ambos inclusive) en el momento de la solicitud."
deadline_2027_intake: NOT APPLICABLE. 2025 general call: "Desde el 1 de abril de 2025 al 30 de mayo de 2025, a las 14:00 h" — closed. The only Becas Leonardo calls currently OPEN (as of 2026-08-25) are Becas Leonardo 2026 – México and Becas Leonardo 2026 – Argentina, Colombia y Perú, i.e. Latin-America-only geographies.
notes: CLEAN DOCUMENTED NO, AND A WHOLE FUNDER CLOSED OFF. Fundación BBVA runs NO master's scholarship of any kind. Its full open/recent catalogue at fbbva.es/convocatorias consists of research prizes (Premios Fronteras del Conocimiento, Vicent Caselles, SCIE, SEBBM, CSIC, RSEF, Biodiversidad), research aid (Ayudas CSIC, Programa Prismas y Problemas), the Becas Leonardo research/creation grants, and the Beca Xabier Lete for literary creation in Basque. None funds tuition or living costs for a taught máster. For Becas Leonardo specifically the candidate fails on THREE independent grounds: (1) the non-EU nationality route requires an already-held Spanish long-term residence card or a Ley 14/2013 residence permit PLUS three years of prior residence in Spain — a first-time student arriving in 2027 has neither; (2) the 30–45 age band; (3) it funds a project, not a degree. NOTE for the wider sweep: the 'three years of prior residence in Spain' construction seen here is the archetypal Spanish-foundation exclusion clause — expect it to recur. Contact: becas-leonardo@fbbva.es.

name: Becas Fundación Telefónica (programa de becas de posgrado tecnológico, 1ª edición 2026)
amount_detail: "La dotación económica máxima de cada beca asciende a OCHENTA MIL EUROS (80.000 EUR) para la totalidad del periodo de disfrute, constituyendo un límite absoluto e infranqueable." Programme total: "4 millones de euros en 2026 para conceder 50 becas anuales". Priority application: "La dotación económica de la beca se aplicará con carácter preferente al pago de la matrícula y de las tasas académicas obligatorias del programa financiado."
covers: Master's tuition and compulsory academic fees as first charge, plus accessory living/travel items inside the global cap. "Las becas podrán concederse por una o dos anualidades, en función de la duración del programa de máster financiado, con un periodo máximo de disfrute de veinticuatro (24) meses." Compatible with other funding ("serán compatibles con ayudas, becas, subvenciones, exenciones arancelarias (fee waivers)…"). MBAs, másteres habilitantes and management-heavy programmes are excluded.
eligibility_verbatim: "Artículo 6. Requisitos de las personas candidatas — 6.1 Nacionalidad. Las personas candidatas deberán ostentar la nacionalidad española. Las personas con doble nacionalidad podrán participar siempre que acrediten su nacionalidad española mediante Documento Nacional de Identidad (DNI) en vigor en el momento de presentar la solicitud. Las personas que se encuentren en proceso de obtención de la nacionalidad española podrán participar en la convocatoria siempre que dispongan del documento oficial acreditativo de dicha nacionalidad antes del cierre del plazo de solicitud. Las personas candidatas que hayan cursado sus estudios de grado en una universidad extranjera deberán acreditar, adicionalmente, su título conforme al artículo 6.3. — 6.2 Edad. Las personas candidatas no podrán haber cumplido treinta y seis (36) años antes del 31 de diciembre de 2026." Website summary of the same: "Requisitos — Formales: Ser ciudadano/a español/a. Tener hasta 35 años en el año de la convocatoria."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: "6.1 Nacionalidad. Las personas candidatas deberán ostentar la nacionalidad española." (Bases de la convocatoria Becas Fundación Telefónica, 1ª edición, junio 2026, artículo 6.1.) A Tunisian citizen without Spanish nationality cannot apply, full stop.
deadline_2027_intake: 1st edition timetable (published): "Apertura de la Convocatoria — 1 de Junio de 2026, 8:00 h. Cierre del plazo de solicitud — 30 de Junio de 2026, 23:59 h. (hora peninsular española). Plazo ampliado para documentación pendiente — Hasta el 1 de septiembre de 2026. Publicación de resultados — A partir del 24 de septiembre de 2026." First-edition applications are now CLOSED ("Proceso de admisión de solicitudes de la primera convocatoria cerrada"). A 2nd edition is announced but its dates are NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25 — the site offers only a notification sign-up form. Moot for this candidate: ineligible on nationality.
notes: THE MOST PAINFUL 'NO' IN THIS BLOCK — record it prominently so nobody wastes time re-discovering it. This is a brand-new (launched 2026), very large and almost perfectly field-matched programme: eligible areas are literally "Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y Ciencia de Datos", "Infraestructuras Digitales, Cloud, Edge, IoT y Computación Avanzada", "Ciberseguridad", "Redes Avanzadas y Telecomunicaciones" — path codes AA, AB, AC — at up to EUR 80,000 per award, 50 awards a year, and it explicitly funds master's study at "universidades e instituciones académicas de reconocido prestigio internacional" (national or international). Everything about it fits the candidate EXCEPT article 6.1, which requires Spanish nationality with a valid DNI. Note that the bases DO contemplate applicants whose bachelor's was earned abroad (art. 6.1 final paragraph refers such candidates to art. 6.3 for título recognition) — so the foreign-degree route is open; only the passport is not. Note also art. 6.2: born on or after 1 January 1991 for the 2026 edition, and the Fundación reserves the right to change the age limit in later editions. Also carries a positive-action reserved quota for women (art. 9.6). Contact via the becas team email published on the programme page. Bases read directly at legal.fundaciontelefonica.com.
